features.name: z_mean_projection
features.description: Training-fold standardized mean projection across all seven inputs, clipped to reduce extreme leverage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the margin a single smooth direction for overall row intensity after variance scaling.

features.name: z_abs_dispersion
features.description: Average absolute standardized deviation from training-fold centers across all seven inputs.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth atypicality magnitude that can be weighted linearly without requiring separate hard cutoffs.

features.name: upper_tail_excess_score
features.description: Average upper-side exceedance beyond one training-fold standard deviation, clipped for stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures smooth upper-side severity across inputs as a compact linear margin component.

features.name: lower_tail_excess_score
features.description: Average lower-side exceedance beyond one training-fold standard deviation, clipped for stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Represents smooth lower-side severity that a linear SVM can combine with upper-side and contrast features.

features.name: x001_x002_contrast
features.description: Signed broad-axis contrast between x001 and x002, clipped to a symmetric interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct linear projection for imbalance between the two widest-range inputs.

features.name: x004_x006_ratio_contrast
features.description: Scale-normalized signed contrast between x004 and x006 using their combined magnitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns mid-scale imbalance into a bounded ratio that is easier for a linear margin to weight consistently.

features.name: x007_mid_bridge_residual
features.description: Residual of x007 relative to the average of x004 and x006, scaled and clipped.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights whether x007 behaves like a bridge component or departs from nearby mid-scale inputs.

features.name: x005_log_intensity
features.description: Log-scaled intensity of the sparse low-magnitude input x005 relative to its training-fold mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses rare x005 spikes into a smooth bounded score suitable for stable linear weighting.

features.name: x005_small_channel_share
features.description: Share of x005 within the combined low-magnitude pair x003 and x005.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes relative dominance of the sparse small component while remaining bounded for linear SVM scaling.

features.name: broad_mid_quadratic_energy
features.description: Average squared energy across the broad and mid-scale inputs x001, x002, x004, x006, and x007.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a simple nonlinear magnitude projection that a linear SVM can use as an extra margin direction.

features.name: profile_coherence_judgment
features.description: Expert 0-to-1 assessment of whether the seven values form a coherent row shape, with aligned broad-scale and mid-scale components and no isolated low-scale spike.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact qualitative consistency axis that may align with a linear margin when exact formulas miss shape-level cues.

features.name: unusual_geometry_judgment
features.description: Expert 0-to-5 severity rating for how atypical the row geometry appears relative to training-fold ranges and centers, considering simultaneous extremes, imbalance, and small-channel spikes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies an interpretable anomaly-like severity measure that can be weighted directly by a linear SVM.
